lesson: In overage_charge, prorate the included quota by calendar day using ceil to round up to the next whole unit, rejecting int() truncation.
why: Truncating down creates rounding artifacts that unfairly charge customers who are under quota, causing billing escalations.
quote: Round UP to the next whole unit, ceil, always

lesson: In meterbill, emit one debug-level summary log with counts per invoice run instead of logging each computed charge individually.
why: The metering worker runs across every subscription nightly, and logging each charge tripped log-volume alerts twice in a quarter.
quote: One debug-level summary per invoice run with counts, not one line per charge

lesson: In overage_charge, bill overage in 50-unit blocks rounded up to the nearest full block multiplied by plan['block_fee'], rejecting per-unit billing.
why: Finance reconciles accounts in whole blocks, and per-unit charges made invoice reconciliation impossible.
quote: Overage bills in blocks of 50 units, rounded UP to a whole block: a partial block bills as a full block.

lesson: In overage_charge, subtract the 25-unit free grace allowance from overage before rounding into 50-unit blocks, rejecting waivers or applying grace after block rounding.
why: Applying grace after rounding produces incorrect block counts (e.g., billing two blocks instead of one for 60 overage units), which requires manual support credits.
quote: the first 25 overage units in a month are free, and the allowance is applied BEFORE the block rounding.

lesson: Do not put overage_charge changes behind a billing feature flag; rollout directly via staging internal tenants first.
why: Billing feature flags rarely get cleaned up, leaving confusion over which formula generated a historical invoice.
quote: No flag - billing flags never get cleaned up and then nobody knows which formula produced an invoice.

lesson: In overage_charge, retain the ValueError exception when day_of_month is not within 1..days_in_month.
why: The input validation guard has actively caught real caller bugs in production.
quote: keep the ValueError for a day outside 1..days_in_month, that guard has caught real caller bugs.
